_comment: Edit this file freely. Changes take effect on the next 5-minute cycle — no restart needed.

allocation_caps._comment: When portfolio_cap_usd is set, caps are ignored — full budget can go into one stock.

focus_topics: unusual spike in X post volume around a cashtag in last 30 min
verified analyst or executive accounts posting bullish signals
short squeeze or unusual options flow chatter on X or Stocktwits
major product launch, partnership, or contract announcement
AI-related demand signal for chip or cloud stocks
breaking news on CNBC or Reuters in last 1 hour
insider buying or large block trade rumors
ignore_topics: general market commentary with no specific catalyst
posts older than 2 hours with no fresh corroboration
price predictions with no fundamental basis
news already reflected in current price movement
